source_quote.quote: Patients with diagnosis of recurrent/progressive IDH mutant gliomas (WHO 2021, grade 2-4).

flag.reason: IDH-mutant cohort is enrolled with a stated PARP-inhibitor rationale (2HG, BRCA-ness) in the description; coded not matched because IDH defines the cohorts and is a diagnostic criterion.

coder_notes: Both IDH wild-type GBM and IDH-mutant grade 2-4 gliomas enrolled (Cohort 1 and 2), GBM named in title and eligibility. Temozolomide dose-dense 7d on/7d off schedule and dose differ from approved use and are part of the question, so established_therapy_experiment (rule 6); niraparib is the only investigational agent. MGMT mentioned only as 'Both MGMT methylated and unmethylated patients are allowed', not an entry requirement, so not listed. Detailed description cites a rationale for PARP inhibition in IDH-mutant gliomas (2HG accumulation and BRCA-ness), which an adjudicator may weigh for candidate_matched.
